hero: Pausing may feel like giving up
拆分难题，先问团队愿意承担多少
Break down the challenge and ask what the team can take on
把原本可以求助的难题也揽下来
Taking on a challenge that could be shared
sage: 担心建立在错误依据上
Worrying about relying on a weak premise
在证据足以试行时约定复查点
Agree on a review point once there is enough evidence to try
在信息已够作小试时还一再推迟
Delaying a small trial after enough information is available
explorer: 把试验限定在一个任务内，并分享发现
Bound an experiment to one task and share what you learn
每次遇到重复工作就换方向
Changing direction every time the work becomes repetitive
creator: 创造者
Creator
做出自己的表达
Giving an idea its own form
担心成品失去原意
Worrying that the work will lose its intent
先交一个能讨论的版本，再改表现形式
Share a draft people can discuss before refining its form
反复打磨表达，让团队一直等初稿
Refining the expression so long that teammates cannot see a draft
ruler: 担心职责不清拖住整体
Worrying that unclear responsibilities will stall the group
明确交接和决定权，同时留出自主空间
Clarify handoffs and decision rights while leaving room for autonomy
把团队每一步都变成审批
Turning every step into an approval
caregiver: Worrying someone will be left without support
先问对方需要什么，约定自己能帮到哪里
Ask what help is wanted and agree on what you can offer
在对方提出需要前就接管任务
Taking over before finding out what help someone wants
magician: 选一个小环节验证新的组合有没有用
Test whether a new combination works in one small part
把每个小问题都当成整体转型的机会
Treating each small problem as a reason to overhaul the whole process
lover: 担心重视的关系变得疏远
Worrying that a valued connection will fade
给彼此专注的时间，也把不同需求说清
Give each other attention and state differing needs clearly
因为重视关系而拖延必要的分歧
Putting off a necessary disagreement to protect the relationship
jester: Worrying the atmosphere will grow stiff
轻松一下后，回到大家要解决的具体问题
Lighten the mood, then return to the concrete issue
每逢困难就转成玩笑，使问题留在原处
Making light of every difficulty and leaving the issue unresolved
everyperson: Worrying someone will be treated as an outsider
留出人人能参与的任务，也听听少数意见
Offer tasks anyone can join and listen to minority views
为了让大家一致而忽略有价值的异议
Overlooking useful dissent for the sake of agreement
innocent: 担心事情失去可信的起点
Worrying there is no trustworthy place to start
找到最小可行步骤，再核对仍需处理的困难
Find a small first step and check what difficulties remain
为了恢复轻松而略过仍需解决的问题
Moving back to a comfortable routine before addressing an unresolved issue
rebel: Worrying old rules will shut out alternatives
指出具体代价，并给出一个可试的替代方案
Name the actual cost and offer one alternative to try
把仍有价值的惯例和无谓的规则一起推翻
Discarding useful practices along with unnecessary rules

Ni: 从零散线索推想一个可能走向
Connect scattered clues into one likely direction
Ne: 从一个线索展开多种可能
Generate multiple possibilities from one starting point
Ti: 检查定义和推论是否一致
Check whether definitions and inferences are consistent
Te: 用可核对的标准推进决定
Move decisions forward using verifiable criteria
Fi: 对照个人认同的价值与边界
Check choices against personal values and boundaries
Fe: 根据共同约定与他人的反应调整做法
Respond to shared expectations and other people's reactions
Si: 用具体经验和过去的细节作对照
Compare the present with specific past experiences
Se: 随眼前可观察到的变化即时调整
Adapt to observable changes in real time
